metadata.title: Secure Institutional Email Pattern (SSPP)
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan Pattern for Secure Institutional Email. This SSPP assembles architectural patterns and establishes the system boundary for assessment and governance. It is vendor-agnostic and realization-independent.

system-characteristics.description: Institutional email capability providing secure, trustworthy, auditable, and compliant messaging and correspondence services.

authorization-boundary.description: Includes institutional email services and associated protection, identity, and records management capabilities. Excludes endpoint devices, user behavior, and external recipient systems.

links.text: Supports Communications Management (BC220) business capability in the Business Reference Model (BRM).

components.title: Secure Institutional Email Pattern
components.description: Composite architectural pattern defining secure institutional email.

control-implementation.description: Control requirements applicable to Secure Institutional Email are defined in referenced architectural patterns and derived catalogs (ISCS, UT-SAFE, UT-REG, UT-ETH). This SSPP does not restate or tailor controls.

system-security-plan.remarks: Concrete products, lifecycle states, baselines, and assessment results are captured in realization artifacts and assessment artifacts separate from this SSPP. The SSPP remains stable across vendor and product changes.
